newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Central U.S. prices firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Central U.S. prices firm.

text.p: Millfeed prices were steady to higher at several central U.S. markets but were weak in northeast where demand has been sluggish, dealers said.
Declining pasture conditions and cool weather boosted feed demand in south central areas and subsequently had feed mixers seeking millfeeds, dealers said.
In the southeast U.S., feed demand is strong but competition from low-priced soybean hulls and corn limited price increases, dealers there said.
Light demand was reported near Buffalo where feedmixers have ample supplies, dealers there said. Demand was steady but supplies were sufficient to match the demand without price increases.
